mapper.sql: id, session_id, user_id, role, content, tool_calls, tokens_used, created_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_agent_conversation (session_id, user_id, role, content, tool_calls, tokens_used, created_at) VALUES (#{sessionId}, #{userId}, #{role}, #{content}, #{toolCalls}, #{tokensUsed}, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT FROM sys_agent_conversation WHERE session_id = #{sessionId} ORDER BY created_at ASC

SELECT t1.* FROM sys_agent_conversation t1 INNER JOIN ( SELECT session_id, MAX(id) AS max_id FROM sys_agent_conversation WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND role = 'user' GROUP BY session_id ) t2 ON t1.id = t2.max_id ORDER BY t1.created_at DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{limit}
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT session_id) FROM sys_agent_conversation WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND role = 'user'
SELECT FROM sys_agent_conversation WHERE session_id = #{sessionId} ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT user_id FROM sys_agent_conversation WHERE session_id = #{sessionId} LIMIT 1
